why: GUARD ON THE BYLINE CLIMB. It widens a hide until it contains who posted it - so an ad with no readable page link would keep climbing, and in a short feed the next thing up holds a real post that does have one. It must stop at the container of posts, and the friend's post beside the ad must survive.
